communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-983841698
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $34.99 on my statement from Digital Goods LLC. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Emily R. Chen

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-983841698
communications.body: I contacted Digital Goods LLC through their online support portal on February 12, 2026. They responded on February 14, 2026, stating that their internal records only show one successful transaction for my account on that date. They suggested that the duplicate charge was likely a 'banking error' and advised me to dispute it with my bank.
